P.name: Gathering Fire
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} ''{{ais|Mantra|Karma}}'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 4 seconds for each enemy champion hit by '''Karma's''' damaging {{tip|abilities}}.

Q.name: Inner Flame
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Karma''' fires a bolt in the target direction that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 40% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

Q.name: Soulflare
Q.description: {{sbc|{{ai|Mantra|Karma}} Bonus:}} ''Inner Flame'' deals increased damage, and fires a larger bolt that also explodes at maximum range.
Q.leveling: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|40 to 220 4}}}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 260 5}} (+ {{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|40 to 220 4}}}}) {{as|(+ {{ap|70+30}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: The explosion creates a field for {{fd|1.5}} seconds that {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies within by 50%, which then ruptures to deal {{as|magic damage}}.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|40 to 310 4}}}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Total Bonus Damage|{{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|40+40 to 220+310 4}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50+30}}% AP)}}|Total Damage|{{ap|60 to 260}} (+ {{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|40+40 to 220+310 4}}}}) {{as|(+ {{ap|70+50+30}}% AP)}}}}

W.name: Focused Resolve
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Karma''' deals {{as|magic damage}} to the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|monster}} or {{tip|pet}} and forms a {{tip|tether}} between her and them for 2 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
W.description2: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is dealt the same {{as|magic damage}} again and is {{tip|root|rooted}} for a duration, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|40*2 to 140*2}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1.6 to 2}} seconds}}

W.name: Renewal
W.description:
{{sbc|{{ai|Mantra|Karma}} Bonus:}} ''Focused Resolve's'' {{tip|root}} duration is increased.

'''Karma''' {{tip|heal|heals}} for {{sti|health|{{as|17% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}} of her '''missing''' health}}}} once on-cast, and again once the tether lasts its full duration or the target dies while tethered.
W.leveling: {{st|Root Duration Increase|{{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|0.5 to 1.25 4}}}} seconds|Total Root Duration|{{ap|1.6 to 2}} (+ {{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|0.5 to 1.25 4}}}}) seconds}}

E.name: Inspire
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Karma''' grants a {{tip|shield}} to herself or the target allied champion for {{fd|2.5}} seconds as well as {{sti|ms|{{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.

E.name: Defiance
E.description:
{{sbc|{{ai|Mantra|Karma}} - Active:}} ''Inspire'' grants a bonus amount of shielding.

''Inspire'' spreads to surrounding allied champions, granting them a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds and {{sti|ms|{{as|15% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.
E.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Primary Target Shield|{{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|45 to 165 4}}}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}|Total Primary Target Shield|{{ap|80 to 280}} (+ {{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|45 to 165 4}}}}) {{as|(+ {{ap|60+45}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Secondary Target Shield|{{ai|Mantra|Karma|{{ap|45*1.0 to 165*1.0 4}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|45*1.0}}% AP)}}}}

R.name: Mantra
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Karma''' empowers her next basic ability within 8 seconds for an additional effect.
R.description2:
'''Karma''' begins the game with one rank in ''Mantra''. Her empowered abilities scale based on ''Mantra's'' rank.

''Mantra can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''
